summary: 30-day satisfaction guarantee on all opened and unopened skincare products.
content: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you experience an adverse skin reaction or are unsatisfied with your routine results, you may initiate a return within 30 days of delivery. Opened products with over 50% content remaining receive a full refund minus a $5 processing fee.

topic: Dynamic Bundle Discounts and AOV Incentives
summary: Automatic tiered discounts when bundling 2, 3, or 4 complementary regimen products.
content: Customers receive an instant 10% discount when purchasing any 2 routine steps (e.g. Cleanser + Serum), 15% discount when purchasing 3 steps (Cleanser + Serum + Moisturizer), and 20% discount on 4-step complete regimens (including SPF). Discounts apply automatically at checkout and stack with free shipping over $50.

summary: Standard shipping is free on orders above $50. 2-day priority available for $9.99.
content: Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST ship the same business day. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days across the continental US and is free for orders over $50. Temperature-controlled packaging is used during summer months to protect active serums like Retinoids and Vitamin C.

topic: Ingredient Safety, Allergens, and Clinical Protocol
summary: 100% cruelty-free, fragrance-free options, and strict dermatological contraindication alerts.
content: All formulations are tested under dermatological control. We strictly warn against combining strong active exfoliants (AHA/BHA) with Retinoids in the same PM routine to prevent moisture barrier breakdown. Vitamin C should not be layered directly with Copper Tripeptides. Patch testing is recommended 24 hours before initial use.
